status: Project-defined analytical assumptions used to convert product sales into stock-item requirements
observed_source: The public workbook provides product transactions, quantities, prices, dates and three source store IDs.
scenario: The source store IDs are relabelled Store A, Store B and Store C for a hypothetical Singapore network supplied by one central hub.
bom: Recipes, ingredient quantities, packaging quantities and ready-to-sell mappings are project definitions; they are not fields supplied by the source dataset.
waste: No unobserved preparation waste, expiry, substitution or shrinkage is added to forecast requirements.
pooling: Forecasting adds the three stores' derived requirements at one hypothetical central hub.
out_of_scope: Opening stock, purchase orders, lead times, pack sizes, shelf lives, costs, fill rates and distribution decisions are outside this release.
